title: Create a feature library
description: Creates an Angular feature library, a feature component, and a domain facade.

directory.description: Feature name, or a nested path whose last segment is the feature name, for example search or admin/users.
directory.x-prompt: What feature name or nested path would you like to use?

domain.description: Existing domain name, for example booking. The domain library must already exist.
domain.x-prompt: Which domain should this feature belong to?
